errors.evidence: The peak of the solid line in 1978 is visibly higher than 10, at approximately 14.
The dotted line starts at a value much closer to 0 in 1946, approximately 2-3. The value 8 is a significant overestimation.
The peak of the dotted line is indeed around 30, but it occurs around 1952-1954, not in 1950. In 1950, the value is lower, at about 25.
The value of the dotted line in 1960 is clearly above 20, at approximately 22-23. The stated value of 15 is a significant underestimate.
The value of the dotted line in 1970 is approximately 15, halfway between the 10 and 20 grid lines. The stated value of 10 is incorrect.
